points.title: です
points.attach: noun or adjective + です
points.explain: Says that something is something: "is", "am", "are". Polite; the plain form is だ, and an い-adjective takes です but never だ.

points.title: も
points.attach: noun + も, in place of は, が or を
points.explain: "Too", "also". It replaces は, が and を, and sits after other particles [にも, でも]. Twice in a row it means "both … and …".

points.title: で
points.attach: place or means + で
points.explain: Where an action happens [学校で勉強する], or what it's done with or by [バスで行く, 日本語で話す].

points.title: に／へ
points.attach: place + に or へ + a verb of going
points.explain: The destination of a movement: "to". へ looks at the direction, に at the arrival point; with 行く, 来る and 帰る either is fine.

points.title: に
points.attach: time, place or person + に
points.explain: A point things land on: a clock time or date [九時に], where something is [部屋にいる], the person something goes to [友だちにあげる], and what you become [医者になる].

points.title: を
points.attach: object + を
points.explain: Marks the thing an action is done to [水を飲む], and the space you move through or leave [道を渡る, 家を出る].

points.title: は
points.attach: topic + は, read わ
points.explain: Marks what the sentence is about, often something already known: "as for …". The new information comes after it.

points.title: と
points.attach: noun + と
points.explain: "And" in a complete list [りんごとバナナ = just those], and "with" someone [友だちと行く].

points.title: から
points.attach: place or time + から
points.explain: A starting point, "from", in place or time; まで marks where it ends [九時から五時まで].

points.title: や
points.attach: noun + や + noun (+ など)
points.explain: "And" in a list that leaves things out: these among others. Often closed with など.

points.title: ～ませんか
points.attach: ます stem + ませんか
points.explain: "Won't you …?" A polite invitation, asked as a negative question so it's easy to turn down.

points.title: ～ましょう
points.attach: ます stem + ましょう
points.explain: "Let's …". A suggestion that the speaker joins in on; the plain form is the volitional [食べよう].

points.title: ～ましょうか
points.attach: ます stem + ましょうか
points.explain: "Shall I …?" or "Shall we …?": offering to do something, or asking what to do [何にしましょうか].

points.title: ～たい
points.attach: ます stem + たい
points.explain: "Want to …". It conjugates like an い-adjective [食べたくない, 食べたかった], and speaks for the speaker; others' wants take たがる.

points.title: ～に行く
points.attach: ます stem + に + 行く／来る／帰る
points.explain: "Go (come, go home) to do …": the purpose of the trip [泳ぎに行く = go swimming].

points.title: ～てください
points.attach: て form + ください
points.explain: "Please do …". A polite request; for "please don't" see ～ないでください.

points.title: ～てもいい
points.attach: て form + もいい
points.explain: "May …", "it's all right to …". As a question it asks permission [入ってもいいですか].

points.title: ～てはいけません
points.attach: て form + はいけません
points.explain: "Must not …". A firm rule or a ban; casual speech shortens it to ちゃいけない.

points.title: ～ている
points.attach: て form + いる
points.explain: An action going on now [読んでいる = is reading], or a state that a change left behind [結婚している = is married].

points.title: まだ～ていません
points.attach: まだ + て form + いません
points.explain: "Haven't … yet". Not ませんでした, which says it didn't happen at all.

points.title: ～てから
points.attach: て form + から
points.explain: "After doing …", one thing and then the next, in that order.

points.title: ～ないでください
points.attach: ない form + でください
points.explain: "Please don't …". A polite request not to do something.

points.title: ～なくちゃいけない
points.attach: ない form minus い + くちゃいけない
points.explain: "Have to …", literally "it's no good not to". Casual; the full forms are なければいけない and なくてはいけない.

points.title: ～たことがある
points.attach: た form + ことがある
points.explain: "Have done … (at some point)": an experience. With ない it means "have never …".

points.title: ～たり～たりする
points.attach: た form + り, twice, then する
points.explain: Doing things like these, among others: a sample of actions, not the full list. Also "sometimes …, sometimes …".

points.title: ～ほうがいい
points.attach: た form or ない form + ほうがいい
points.explain: "Had better …", "should …": advice. After a verb it's usually the た form, even about the future.

points.title: ～まえに
points.attach: dictionary form + まえに
points.explain: "Before doing …". The verb stays in the dictionary form even about the past. After a time it means "ago" [一時間前に].

points.title: ～つもり
points.attach: dictionary form or ない form + つもり
points.explain: "Plan to …", "intend to …": a decision already made.

points.title: ～のが好き
points.attach: dictionary form + のが好き
points.explain: "Like doing …". の turns the verb into a thing, and 好き takes it with が.

points.title: ～のが上手
points.attach: dictionary form + のが上手
points.explain: "Good at doing …". Said of other people; of yourself it sounds like boasting, so 得意 is used.

points.title: ～のが下手
points.attach: dictionary form + のが下手
points.explain: "Bad at doing …".

points.title: ～くなる／～になる
points.attach: い-adjective minus い + くなる; な-adjective or noun + になる
points.explain: "Become …", "get …": a change of state [寒くなった = it got cold, 医者になる].

points.title: ～すぎる
points.attach: ます stem, or adjective minus い／な, + すぎる
points.explain: "Too much", "too …". It conjugates as an ichidan verb [食べすぎた].

points.title: ～があります
points.attach: place に + thing + があります
points.explain: "There is …", "have …" for things and plants, and for events.

points.title: ～がいます
points.attach: place に + person or animal + がいます
points.explain: "There is …", "have …" for people and animals, anything that moves by itself.

points.title: ～のほうが～より
points.attach: A のほうが B より + adjective
points.explain: "A is more … than B". Either half can be left out once the comparison is clear.

points.title: ～の中で～が一番
points.attach: group の中で + thing が一番 + adjective
points.explain: "Of all …, … is the most …". With two things it's のほうが instead.

points.title: ～んです
points.attach: plain form + んです; な-adjective or noun + なんです
points.explain: Gives or asks for an explanation: "it's that …". Questions with どうして and answers to them often take it.

points.title: ～ので
points.attach: plain form + ので; な-adjective or noun + なので
points.explain: "Because …", "so …", stated as a fact; から says the same with more of the speaker's own reasoning.

points.title: ～でしょう
points.attach: plain form + でしょう; な-adjective or noun + でしょう
points.explain: "Probably …", or "…, right?" checking with the listener. The plain form is だろう.
